crossRefs.note: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance…
If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
“Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service…
Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases…
Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.
that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it…
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, And its land will become burning pitch.
It won’t be quenched night nor day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No…
The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who…
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…

translations.web: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
translations.bsb: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur rains down on his dwelling.
translations.kjv: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
translations.asv: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his: Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
